params.prompt: Traditional Rajasthani Phad scroll painting (phad), Marwar folk art: flat two-dimensional figures in strict profile, bold black outlines, saturated mineral pigments on cloth — deep red-ochre ground, indigo, turmeric yellow, white — dense storytelling composition with a decorative patterned border on all sides, stylized large-eyed figures, no perspective, no shading, aged hand-woven cloth texture showing through the paint. Absolutely no readable text, no letters, no writing, no inscriptions anywhere. A night scene at a small village shrine (devra) of Tejaji: a weathered devotee kneels in profile before a small stone shrine holding up a red sacred thread with both hands, one oil lamp burning on the shrine, a painted horse standing behind him, dark indigo night sky field above with white stars, the shrine tiny against the dark.
